reviewStatus: Graphical proxy adopted by the assistant after visual sample inspection; no human anatomical, support-contact or IK approval.
scope: hold and swing per-frame grip proxies; attach uses final pose constant; release uses initial pose constant
assumptions: Hands are the two highest opaque connected components in the selected frames.
No attempt to measure early attach or late release with this heuristic because mask/fingers become the highest components.
A combined fist center is not the actual grip contact of either hand and cannot enforce both hand positions.
Per-frame pivot translation preserves all relative drawing pixels and limb motion but changes world presentation; applied here to draft metadata only.
Different hand spacing, body scale and angle between pages remain artistic differences; a pivot cannot repair them.
The gameplay support point and pendulum phase remain authoritative; a review anchor is not an active IK binding.
